name: Hyonosen-Ushiroyama-Nagisan Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 氷ノ山後山那岐山国定公園
aliases: 氷ノ山後山那岐山国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of Mt. Hyonosen and the Hyogo-Okayama-Tottori border peaks, with deep snow in winter and alpine flowers in summer.
notes: Managed by Hyogo/Okayama/Tottori. The Yabu and Haga highlands are the hiking bases.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
businessHours: Open access (park; facility hours vary by season and area)
